# explosionprooftablets.com: full reference

> Engineering reference comparing ATEX and IECEx certified Zone 1 and Zone 2 tablets and iPad Ex solutions for hazardous areas, for HSE and procurement teams.
Last updated: 2026-09-28

## Zones and certification
Zone 1: an explosive gas atmosphere is likely in normal operation. Zone 2: it is unlikely and short-lived. Zone 21/22 are the dust equivalents.
A Zone 1 certified tablet may be used in Zone 1 and Zone 2. A Zone 2 tablet must not be used in Zone 1.
ATEX is mandatory in the EU/EEA; IECEx is the international scheme. Check the certificate of conformity for the exact model variant.
Gas group IIC (hydrogen, acetylene) also covers IIA and IIB. The temperature class (T1–T6) must suit the gases on site.
No consumer Samsung, Apple or Google tablet is intrinsically safe in its standard form.

## Solutions compared (no prices; available on request)
- **Xshielder iPad Pro 11**, Xshielder (Norway): Zone 1/21, ATEX. Ex db flameproof case for the Apple iPad Pro 11" (M4/M5), iPadOS, ~1.4 kg. Marking II 2G Ex db IIC T6 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIC T80°C Db. 11" tandem OLED display, Apple M4/M5, Face ID. ATEX certified; no IECEx certificate. Source: https://xshielder.com/products/atex-ipad
- **ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ1**, ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs): Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. Android 13 tablet built on Samsung Galaxy Tab Active hardware, IP68, ~690 g. Display as listed on the site: 10.1" TFT. Gas group IIC. Source: https://ecom-ex.com
- **ecom Tab-Ex Pro DZ1**, ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs): Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. 10.1" AMOLED Android 13 tablet with S Pen, IP68, ~750 g. Gas group IIC. Source: https://ecom-ex.com
- **i.safe MOBILE IS930.1**, i.safe MOBILE: Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. Compact 8" IPS Android 12 tablet, IP68, ~570 g. Gas group IIC. Source: https://isafe-mobile.com
- **Aegex 10 IS**, Aegex Technologies: Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. 10.1" IPS Windows 10/11 tablet, IP65, ~850 g. One of two Zone 1 Windows tablets compared on the site (with the Bartec Agile X IS). Source: https://aegex.com
- **Bartec Agile X IS**, Bartec: Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. Windows 10 IoT tablet for Zone 1. Compared with the ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ1 on the site. Source: https://explosionprooftablets.com/ecom-tab-ex-vs-bartec-agile.html
- **Getac F110-Ex**, Getac: Zone 2, ATEX. 11.6" IPS Windows 11 tablet, IP66, ~1.4 kg. Zone 2 only: not for Zone 1. Source: https://getac.com
- **Zebra XPAD L10 IS**, Zebra (Xplore): Zone 2, ATEX, IECEx. 10.1" Android or Windows tablet, IP65, ~1.1 kg. Zone 2 only: not for Zone 1. Source: https://zebra.com
- **Xciel XCZ1 iPad mini 7**, Xciel (USA): Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. Flameproof enclosure for the iPad mini 4–7, factory-fitted only. iPadOS in the compact format. Source: https://www.xciel.com/rugged-ipads
- **Atexxo iPad 11" Zone 1**, Atexxo Manufacturing (Netherlands): Zone 1/21, ATEX, IECEx. Announced: converted Apple iPad 11", ~1,100 g. Marking Ex db IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIA T135°C Db. Source: https://atexxo.com/product/explosion-proof-ipad-11-inch-ex-zone-1/
- **Atexxo iPad (A16) Ex**, Atexxo Manufacturing (Netherlands): Zone 2/22, ATEX. Factory-converted Apple iPad 11" (A16), ~1,050 g. Marking II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T135°C Dc. Zone 2/22 only. Source: https://atexxo.com/product/explosion-proof-ipad-a16-ex-zone-2/
- **Xciel XCRiPad Pro 11**, Xciel (USA): Zone 2, ATEX, US C1D2. Rugged Ex case for the iPad Pro 11"; versions for iPad, iPad Air and iPad mini too. Zone 2 / Class I Division 2 only. Source: https://www.xciel.com/rugged-ipads
